    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray) or arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D numpy array")

            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values (must be log probabilities)")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all three matrices must have the same shape")
    
    n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights
    t = np.arange(horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    norm_weights = raw_weights / np.sum(raw_weights)
    # Compute weighted losses (negative weighted log probability)
    loss_with = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
    loss_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
    loss_no_call = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)

    loss_minus = np.minimum(loss_no_call, loss_call_only)
